Class ViewController

java.lang.Object
Presentation.ViewController
public class ViewController extends Object
Controller that mediates between the UserInterface and the Business layer managers. It owns the session state (logged-in client and active cart) and drives all menu flows. No Persistence classes are imported here; the controller never touches the DAO layer directly.

  • Constructor Details

    • ViewController

      public ViewController(ClientManager clientManager, ProductManager productManager, ProviderManager providerManager, SaleManager saleManager, ShoppingManager shoppingManager)
      Constructs a ViewController with all required business-layer managers. No Persistence objects are passed; the controller stays in the Presentation layer.
      Parameters:
      clientManager - manages client login and registration
      productManager - manages product search operations
      providerManager - manages provider lookup operations
      saleManager - manages sale recording and history retrieval
      shoppingManager - manages cart and checkout operations

  • Method Details

      public void start()
      Main entry point of the application. Runs the authentication menu in a loop until the user chooses to exit.
